name: College of Swords
summary: Blade-juggling showfighters who weave flourishes into every attack.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.summary: You gain proficiency with medium armor and the scimitar. You can use a simple or martial melee weapon you are proficient with as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.summary: You adopt a style of fighting as your specialty.

options.name: Dueling
options.summary: When you wield a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, +2 to damage rolls with it.

options.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
options.summary: Add your ability modifier to the damage of your off-hand attack.

features.name: Blade Flourish
features.short: Faster when attacking; spend inspiration on Defensive, Slashing or Mobile flourish.
features.summary: When you take the Attack action, your walking speed increases by 10 ft. until the end of the turn. Once per turn on a weapon hit, you can spend a Bardic Inspiration die for a flourish: Defensive (add the die to damage and AC), Slashing (damage the target and another nearby creature) or Mobile (damage and push the target).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.short: Attack twice with the Attack action.
features.summary: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Master's Flourish
features.short: Use a d6 for a flourish instead of spending inspiration.
features.summary: Whenever you use a Blade Flourish option, you can roll a d6 and use it instead of expending a Bardic Inspiration die.
